verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents a Pay by Bank / Payments API v3 product for making and accepting payments, scoped explicitly to the UK and EU. It covers request signing, webhooks, testing via a UK merchant-account quickstart, and mandate-based recurring payments (VRP, Direct Debit). Bank coverage per European country can be queried through the providers endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that payments initiate as documented, and an explicit per-country list of live markets beyond the high-level "UK and EU" statement.
